CustomField.formula: TEXT(FLOOR((End_Date_Time__c - Start_Date_Time__c))) & " Day(s) " & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD((End_Date_Time__c - Start_Date_Time__c) * 24, 24))) & " Hour(s) " & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD((End_Date_Time__c - Start_Date_Time__c) * 24 * 60, 60))) & " Minute(s)"
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Duration between Start Date/Time and End Date/Time
CustomField.label: Duration
